race.description: Nadine Stevens Legal C,G&E Mdn Plate
race.comment: BOLD BUCKS (9) found the 1000m too short first up with a tiring fourth over 1100m at Gosford. Expected to go on with it now in this weaker contest and did place at Gosford in his first prep. Go close. PIERIPPER (12) returns a gelding after four-and-a-half months in the paddock. Gets map favours from the low draw and has trialled well. Value contender. THE HARD ROAD (8) is from the in-form Ible camp and expected to go on with it this prep. Trialled okay and worth thought. POWER HUNGRY (6) is still chasing his elusive maiden win after 14 career starts. Last appeared when second over 1100m at this track on August 10. Include in all multiples.
